item.title: Observe and report: Neighbourhood watch aims to make Fairhaven safer
item.description: A recruitment event is being held at Confederation Inn at 7 p.m. on March 18, and Pearce is hopeful it will bring in a lot more volunteers.

item.title: Wanted man arrested after climbing tree to avoid RCMP on Thunderchild First Nation
item.description: Trying to avoid arrest, the 34-year-old man fled into the woods. An RCMP Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS) found him climbing a tree.

item.title: 'It doesn’t always go your way': McMorris reflects on fourth Olympics
item.description: The 32-year-old from Regina placed eighth in men’s snowboard slopestyle, marking the first time he hasn't won a medal in four Winter Games.

item.title: Ministry denies Saskatoon woman's plea for brain surgery travel coverage
item.description: Tammy O'Brien has started a petition to call on the government to "amend the healthcare policy and provide financial support for residents who must leave the province to obtain medically necessary treatments or procedures."

item.title: Toys "R" Us Canada no longer accepting gift cards
item.description: The retailer officially stopped accepting gift cards after Monday, following a court-approved deadline tied to creditor protection proceedings.

item.title: Explore a winter festival: Five things to do this weekend in Saskatoon, Feb. 20-22
item.description: Take in a musical theatre variety show, a music workshop, Indigenous culture festival and storytelling, and an information lecture.

item.title: New location being considered for Saskatoon drop-in centre
item.description: The Avenue C South drop-in centre for women could be moving for a third time over concerns about the concentration of services in that area.

item.title: No appeal hearing for dismissed Saskatoon police officers, judge rules
item.description: An "error of counsel" set off the chain of events.

item.title: Sask., federal governments continue funding for 2026 Crop Insurance Program
item.description: SCIC CEO Jeff Morrow said Friday that in the last five years about $8 billion in claims have been paid out across the province.

item.title: Saskatoon man accused of assaulting child, sexually assaulting woman
item.description: Police say they were responding to a domestic assault call at a home on Avenue U South when a three-year-old boy opened the door.
